summary:
Complete Architecture Analysis & Comprehensive Viva Voce Guide for Project Incubator:
1. Detailed Frontend Architecture (React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Context API, state flow, component hierarchy).
2. Detailed Backend Architecture (Node/Vite middleware proxy, Google GenAI SDK, Gemini 3.8 Flash, security & API key boundary).
3. 25+ High-yield Viva Voce questions and answers covering System Design, State Management, API integration, Algorithms, Scalability, Security, and Relational Database schema roadmap.
4. Tricky examiner edge cases and 2-minute project pitch talk-track.
5. In-app Viva Voce Modal and Print-to-PDF button implementation plan.
